reviewConclusions.subject: Default behavior
reviewConclusions.finding: Absent/false flag leaves cache uncalled and legacy inverse evaluator, remap/order, flat-normal branch and output path unchanged. True flag requires the analytic-normal Bool. Retained f4 default-false rebuild exactly reproduces original USDZ/descriptor bytes.

reviewConclusions.subject: Exact facet and UV ownership
reviewConclusions.finding: Unordered exact three-position facet signature, unique face owner, and exactly one finite usable UV witness per vertex are all required. Ownership is recorded before UV lookup, so missing UV does not hide a second owner. Invalid coincident witnesses retain ambiguity. Uninspectable tessellation invalidates acceleration; unavailable UV uses fallback.

reviewConclusions.subject: C0 safety and normals
reviewConclusions.finding: Internal knot multiplicity >= degree marks derivative-side ambiguity, forcing legacy fallback for affected facets. Unit normalization and winding-sign handling remain in shared output path. Existing remap-related semantic sliver limitations remain explicitly reported; no universal normal-winding claim.

reviewConclusions.subject: Real ownership regression
reviewConclusions.finding: Native cylindrical facet and nearby native plane exercise the actual failure mechanism, independent of package/scratch geometry. Test compares to actual cylinder inverse-normal and requires the legacy result to differ; retained legacy-only mutation fails and unchanged f4 passes. Reversed winding, missing/ambiguous UV, coincident faces, false triangle signatures, C0 knots and no-flag behavior have native coverage.

reviewConclusions.subject: Honest contract/evidence
reviewConclusions.finding: README explicitly distinguishes opt-in exact-face ownership from legacy centroid selection. Same-source192-corner proof retains191 legacy agreements and1 actual-owner inverse agreement, while preserving raw7.161516-degree review-required report.
